subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.

He ______ his bike as fast as he could to reach home.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option (1)' **i.e.* 'rode'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rode**: Past tense of ride, which means to travel by sitting on a bicycle, horse, etc. (सवार होकर यात्रा करना)

 
 
• **Example**: He rode his bike as fast as he could to reach home.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option (1)' i.e.* 'rode'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Road**: A wide way leading from one place to another, typically one with a specially prepared surface which vehicles can use (सड़क) 

 
 
• **Example**: The road was closed for repairs.
 
 
 
• **Rowed**: Past tense of row, which means to propel a boat with oars (चप्पू चलाना)
 
 
• **Example**: They rowed across the lake.
 
 
 
• **Rote**: Mechanical or habitual repetition of something to be learned (रटकर याद करना)
 
 
• **Example**: Learning by rote is not always effective.
